data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Real-Time Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Develop a real-time dashboard with various Chart.js graphs.
acceptance_criteria: Display LLM cost over time with a line chart
Show stage completion rates with a bar chart
Illustrate success rate trends with an area chart

features.title: 8-Stage Pipeline Visualization
acceptance_criteria: Accurately represent each stage of the pipeline
Use a clear and informative chart type
Ensure the visualization is easy to understand

features.title: Results Section with Real Metrics
features.description: Showcase real metrics from recent runs in the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Include actual data in the results section
Ensure data is presented clearly and effectively
Use charts to enhance understanding of the metrics

features.title: Chart.js Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js for data visualization within the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Include pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates visualizations
Use appropriate chart types for each data set
Ensure charts are interactive and visually appealing

features.title: HTML Presentation Template
features.description: Create a standalone HTML presentation using existing demos as templates.
acceptance_criteria: Use templates from specified directory
Embed CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js within a single HTML file
Ensure the presentation is professional and cohesive

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Display code quality metrics using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Include TDD compliance and SOLID principles
Use a radar chart for comprehensive visualization
Ensure metrics are accurate and up-to-date

features.title: Professional Design Elements
features.description: Incorporate professional gradient backgrounds and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Use gradient backgrounds that enhance readability
Implement smooth slide transitions
Ensure design elements are consistent throughout the presentation

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Accurately depict integration data
Use a pie chart for clear representation
Ensure the chart is interactive

features.title: HERO Section: Introduction to Artemis
features.description: Create an introductory slide explaining Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
acceptance_criteria: Clearly define Artemis and its capabilities
Use engaging visuals and text
Ensure the introduction sets the stage for the rest of the presentation

features.title: Auto-Advance Slides
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality with navigation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration
Users can manually navigate between slides
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive
